scope: Exploratory PolypGen pilot; both training and validation sequences informed prior experiments. No held-out or patient independence claim.
method: Keep SAM2's native memory and learn residual regional readouts. For each clip, prompt the first frame with its ground truth mask; encode subsequent predictions, with loss on the four post-prompt frames. Sample with the pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler. All heads use identical clips and separately initialized optimizers.
evaluation: Full autonomous propagation and equal-sequence present-frame Dice; also record boundary F, false alarms and return episodes. The four-sequence comparison is exploratory and cannot establish a reliable improvement.
rationale: Broader clip sampling and a smaller learning rate are exploratory responses to the severe order sensitivity of training on three pairs; they do not isolate the source of instability.
